book.title: Phawuloosi Qorontoose Asaas Xaafida Koyro Kiita

content: Imotatan Bessiza Mala Go7eteth
Siiqo kaallite; ayana imotata harappeka tinbite haasayza imotata lo7eththi koyite.
Hara qaalan haasayzaadey Xoossas attiin asas haasayenna; xuura gidida yo7o Ayanan haasayza gishshas izi gizay asas gelenna.
Tinbite haasayzaadey as minththeththanaas, denththeththanaassinne go7anaas haasayees.
Hara qaalan haasayzaadey qasse barkka bana minththeththees; tinbite haasayzaadey gidikko Woosa Keeththaa go7ees.

Intte wurikka hara qaalan haasayzaakko ta dosays shin hessafekka bollara intte tinbite qaalan haasayzaakko ta dosays; Woosa keeththay minnana mala hara qaalara haasayzaadey ba haasayzayssa birshontta izi hara qaalara haasayzayssafe tinbite haasayzaadey aadhdhees.
Hessa gishshas ta ishatoo! Ta intteko biza wode ta inttes qoncciseththan woykko erateththan woykko tinbiten, woykko timirten yootontta hara qaalara yootikko hessi inttena ay go7anee?
Hessi coo susul7e malanne diiththa mala shemppoy baynda istta giirissas dummateththi shaaketti erettontta aggiko iza wostti eranee?
Qasseka xurumbay aazas punettizaakko woykko zayey aazas zayettizaakko shaakki erettontta ogera punettiko ooni olas giigettanee?
Intteka hessa mala; intte doonappe erettiza qaalay kezontta aggiko intte gizayssa ooni eranee? Coo mela carkon dhayana.
Alame bolla daro dumma dumma qaalay dees shin birsheththi baynda qaalay baa.
Hessa gishshas issaadey haasayza qaalaa birsheth ta erontta aggiko haasayzaades tani imath gidays; izaadeyka taas imath gidees.
Intteka hessa mala Ayanan imoteththata demmanaas koyza gishshas Woosa Keeththa go7iza imotata demmanaas lo7eththi koyite.
Hessa gishshas hara qaalan haasayza asi ba haasaydayssa birsheth erana mala baas woosso.
Tani hara qaalara woossiza wode ta Ayanan woossays attiin ta izappe aykkoka erikke.
Histtiin ta ay ooththana mala taas bessizee? Tani ta Ayanankka woossana; wozinan woththadakka woossana; ta Ayanankka yexxana. Wozinarakka yexxana.
Hessaththo gidontta aggiko ne Xoos Ayanan galatiza wode hessa erontta issi imaththa asi ne galata woosaa wostti, «Amiin» gaanaas dandayzee?
Ne bessiza mala galatanaas dandayaasa; hankkoyssi gidikko izan go7ettenna.
Tani inttefe bollara hara qaalan haasayza gishshas Xoos galatays.
Gido attiin Woosa Keeththan erettontta daro shii qaalata haasayanaappe hara asata tamaarsanaas asay eriza ichchash qaalan haasayana dosays.
Ta ishatoo! Intte intte qofan guuththa nayta mala gidopite; iita oosos gidikko guuththa nayta mala gidite; qofan gidikko kaha kunththida asata gidite.
Kase wogaankka,
geetetti kase Geeshsha Maxaafan xaafettides.
Hessa gishshas hara qaalan haasayay ammanontta asaas malata gidees attiin ammanizaytas malata gidenna; tinbitey gidikko ammanizaytas attiin ammanonttaytas gidenna.

Histtiko Woosa Keeththan ammaniza asay issife shiiqidason wurikka erontta hara qaalan haasayshin hessa erontta asati woykko ammanontta asay shiiqidi haasayzaaso gelikko, «Hayti gooyeettes» geettennee?
Gido attiin asay wuri tinbite qaala haasayettishin imaththi woykko ammanonttaadey gelikko ba siyidayssa ubbaa erananne he qaalan pirdettana.
Izaadey ba wozinan qotti woththidaazi wuri qonccananne izikka ba baggara, «Tumappe Xoossi inttenara dees» giidi gufanni Xoossas goynnana.

Hessa gishshas ta ishatoo! Histtiin ay giinoo? Intte issife shiiqiza wode inttefe issi issi asas mazamure qasse issi issi asas timirtey dees; issi issi asas qonccontta xuura miishshata qonccisiza imotay dees; hara asas dumma qaalan haasayana imotay dees; haras qasse he qaalaa birshiza imotay dees; hessi he imotay wurikka ammanizayta go7anaas bessees.
Hara qaalara haasayzay diikko nam7u as woykko dari darikko heedzdzu gididi taran taran yootetto; hara asi qasse birsho.
Birshizaadey baynda aggiko shiiqida asaa giddon co7u giidi baas xallanne Xoossas xalla yooto.
Tinbite haasaya imotay diza nabeti nam7ati woykko heedzdzati tinbite haasayetto; hankko asay yootettidayssa lo7eththi paacco.
Uttida asaa garsafe issaadey issi miishshi qoncciko koyro haasayzayssi co7u go.
Intte garsafe issi issi asi taamarana malanne minettana mala intte wurikka taran taran tinbite yootanaas dandayeeta.
Nabeta ayanay nabetas azazettees; gaasoykka Xoossi saroteththa Xoossafe attiin wocama Xoos gidenna; ammanizayta Woosa Keeth ubbasonkka hessa mala.
Ammaniza asay goynos shiiqizason maccassati co7u getto; Muse wogay kase gida mala istti azazetteto attiin shiiqoson istti haasayana mala isttas imettibeenna.
Maccassati eranaas koyza issi issi yo7oti diikko ba keeththan ba azinata oychchetto; gaasoykka maccassi shiiqoson haasayay yeellachchizaaza.
Xoossa qaalay inttefe kezidee? Woykko intteko xalla gakkidee?
Oonikka bana, «Nabe» giikko woykko, «Taas Xillo Ayanappe imotay dees» gizaadey diikko hayssi ta inttes xaafidayssi Godaa azazo gididayssa ero.
Hayssa erontta asi diikko izi ba hu7es erettenna.
Hessa gishshas ta ishatoo! Buro tinbite haasayanaas lo7eththi koyite; dumma dumma qaalan haasayakka diggofte.
Gidikkoka wurikka maararanne wogara gido.
